content:
One of the Business process I had observed in the National
University is the accounting process. As I log in my Nuis and
check the transaction history, I can cleary see the amount I paid
and the amount i have yet needed to pay. The accounting data
is constructed in a form wherein it is really easy to understand.

For example in a case wherein I paid more than what’s needed
to be paid, I will get a clear output of the excess payment I
made and will be used to deduct the next enrollment
transaction. As a user, It will be a good impression for these
data to be easily understandble.
